prompt:
Create a production Greek fantasy RPG inventory sprite atlas matching the reference painterly leather and metal style. Exactly SIX separate equipment icons, 1536 by 1024 transparent canvas, three columns by two rows, 512 square cells. Every complete object must fit within its own central 410 by 420 area with at least 45px empty transparent margin on all sides. No clipped fingers, soles or ornaments. Each theme needs a distinct silhouette and construction, not only a recolor. TRUE ALPHA transparent background, including gaps between paired objects and holes in buckles. No ground, shadow plate, pedestal, glow cloud, frame, border, text, labels or UI. No character, skin or human body wearing the gear. Clean antialiased cutout edges.
Each cell contains ONE PAIR of lightweight assassin full finger leather GLOVES with small wrist bracers. Two separate empty gloves, naturally curved five complete leather fingers each. No forearms, skin or hands inside. Compact soft leather gloves, never bulky knight gauntlets. One clearly readable pair in each cell.
Cell order left to right top then bottom: T1 supple brown leather and bronze laurel with green gem; T2 navy leather and silver owl clasp with blue gem; T3 moss green leather with vine embossing; T4 sea blue leather with silver waves and turquoise; T5 dark red leather with angular bronze meander; T6 charcoal leather with iron trim and tiny orange rune.
